purpose: Pinned GGUF model weights baked into the Termini pre-baked image. Resolves blocking question BQ-1 (exact Hugging Face distills behind the deepseek-flash / deepseek-v4-pro aliases).
pinning_rule: A model is only admitted to the image if sha256 matches this file; 40-models.sh aborts the bake on mismatch.
shipped_resident_note: Node C's shipped decision model is Gemma 3 4B IT (alias `gemma`, Google open weights) served by the shipped single-model llama.cpp deployment (infra/gcp/cloud-init/llama-serve.sh). The `deepseek-*` entries below remain in the catalog as the documented reference distills (R11/BQ-1) and are staged to disk, but the shipped node-c resident alias is now `gemma`.
